Recipe.Title: Redhead Carrots
Recipe.Description:
Almost nobody in Ransom's family likes sweet potatoes, or yams. This slightly sweet recipe takes their place at Thanksgiving.
Also, most of Ransom's family members have red hair, so we are considered "Gingers". And, since Ginger is one of the primary ingredients, the name "Redhead Carrots" seemed appropriate.

section.instruction: Peel Carrots and cut into 1&inches; chunks.
Pull all ingredients into a saucepan.
Place on stove and heat on high until it is boiling.
Reduce heat to medium/medium low and simmer until Carrots are soft.

Modifications.modification: You can create the Double-Strength Chicken Broth by using 2 Cups Water + 4 Chicken Bouillon Cubes (or the equivalent).
For a little kick, add ½ teaspoon White Pepper.
